benchmark_metadata.name: Faithfulness & Atomic Claim Groundedness Evaluation
benchmark_metadata.evaluation_methodology: Deterministic token-level semantic entailment and NLI keyword verification of extracted atomic claims against retrieved reference context chunks.

scientific_claim_statement: 155/226 (68.6%) evaluated atomic claims were directly supported by retrieved reference contexts. No universal claim of 'zero hallucinations' is asserted across unconstrained production inputs.
